focus: Signing out now ends your session with our identity provider, not just with us. We also fixed a bug that could show a signed-out screen to a member who was in fact signed in — it now retries, and tells you plainly if it still cannot connect. While building this we found the provider lists two capabilities it has not built yet, so we reported it and made our side wait honestly rather than pretend it worked.
nextStep: The members area on the live site is still the older sign-in page. Getting the new one published is the next step.
